experimental_design: Group comparison analysis of peptides (LiP-MS samples) and proteins (tryptic digestion-only proteome) was performed independently within Perseus (version 1.6.5) for all search algorithms.
number_of_biological_replicates: an independent patient cohort including healthy control (n = 4) and OSCC patients (n = 8, pN0 = 4, pN+ = 4).
number_of_samples: an independent patient cohort including healthy control (n = 4) and OSCC patients (n = 8, pN0 = 4, pN+ = 4).
technology_type: we employed limited proteolysis–mass spectrometry in saliva samples to explore structural alterations, comparing the proteome of healthy control and oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) patients with and without lymph node metastasis.
